integrity: Signed traces independently computed on direct cut chains and Alexander-dual chains for all 336 automorphisms. The code and actual output are included.
scientific_limitations: The previously known nonequivariant wedge of 188 nine-spheres is background. New result is the full rational automorphism character and rational quotient acyclicity; no integral representation lattice, equivariant homotopy classification or quotient contractibility is asserted. Priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: The full automorphism character of Heawood four-cut homology
